title: Tonsil removal
what: An ENT surgeon removes the tonsils through the mouth, with no cuts on the skin. The surgery is usually done under general anesthesia.
why: For frequent severe strep throat or tonsillitis, for complications of tonsillitis, or for large tonsils that make it hard to breathe during sleep.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; usually 1 to 3 days in the hospital
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners and painkillers. Your doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you or your relatives bleed easily
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
If you or your relatives ever had problems with anesthesia
If you have tonsillitis or a cold now. The surgery may be moved

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, including clotting tests, and sometimes an ECG. Your clinic will give you the list.

prepare.title: Anesthesiologist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthesiologist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the evening before and no drinks for a few hours before. Your clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: At home
prepare.text: Stock up on soft foods ahead of time: mashed potatoes, porridge, yogurt, cool soups.

bring: Things for 1 to 3 days in the hospital
steps: On the day of surgery, you change clothes and an IV is put in a vein
In the operating room, the anesthesiologist gives the medicine and you fall asleep
Through your open mouth, the surgeon removes the tonsils
You wake up in the recovery room, then you are moved to a regular room
feel: A sore throat, especially when swallowing. You will get pain medicine
The pain may spread to your ears. This is normal
Pain is usually worse in the first 5 to 7 days, then it eases
after: A white coating forms in your throat. This is healing, not infection
Usually for 10 to 14 days, eat soft, warm or cool food. Nothing hot, spicy, or hard
Drink plenty of water in small sips
For about 2 weeks, no heavy lifting and no sauna
Take only the painkillers your doctor prescribed
red_flags: Any blood from your mouth or in your saliva: call emergency services right away, even a week after surgery
You cannot drink liquids, or you pass very little urine

faq.q: How long does the throat hurt after tonsil removal?
faq.a: Usually 1 to 2 weeks. It hurts most in the first days and on days 5 to 7, when the coating comes off.

faq.q: Will my immunity get weaker without tonsils?
faq.a: Research shows it usually does not. Other lymph nodes and throat tissues do the protective work.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Pack your things, your ID, and your list of medicines. Eat and drink only until the times your clinic gave you.
